paragraphs: A Salmonella outbreak linked to raw oysters is ongoing, with 27 cases, 5 hospitalizations, and no deaths reported across 12 states as of October 19 [1]. Kayem Foods Inc. issued a Class I recall of various ready-to-eat meat and poultry products due to possible temperature abuse; consumers should check for products bearing "EST. M/P 7839," "EST. P 20935A," or "EST. M 9520" inside the USDA inspection mark and avoid them [2]. The FDA issued a public warning about cold smoked sprats from D&M Smoked Fish Inc. (operating as Haifa Smoked Fish Inc.) because the product was produced without controls for Clostridium botulinum; the company has refused to recall the item [8].

Natural Grocers Brand Organic 2-Pound Mung Beans are being recalled due to potential glass contamination [3]. WinCo Foods is recalling WinCo Foods Brand Hoagie Rolls because they contain undeclared sesame [4]. Wild West Seed Inc. is recalling nearly 10,000 pounds of broccoli sprouting seeds in two lots due to Salmonella contamination [10].
